hero.title: LC-101 – Historical step test catalogue
hero.sub: Inlet separator | oil-outlet level | Interactive assessment of 26 prolonged MAN windows

summary: Across 2022-01-01 to 2025-12-31 (UTC), the LC_101.MODE historian recorded 196 state transitions, of which 97 entered MAN. Applying the >=30 min duration and OP filters yielded 26 windows for review. The interactive catalogue groups them into 1 likely startup, 9 likely APC, 11 likely cascade/external-control, and 5 likely step-test windows.

How to read this: the assessments are evidence-weighted hypotheses, not definitive ownership records. The highest-scoring likely step-test window is 2024-03-12 08:10 to 2024-03-12 11:25 UTC; it scores 79/100. Filter, sort, inspect evidence, and click any of the 26 period rows to expand or collapse its trace.
